verdict.rationale: Clara documents a REST API for retrieving and filtering transactions, including billing-period pulls and last-update date ranges, and a probe confirms a live OpenAPI schema. Credentials are self-managed per project from the dashboard and the code examples use mTLS, but nothing shows OAuth flows or scoped tokens, and receipt or expense-report retrieval is not documented. Missing for 10: documented OAuth flow, token scopes/permission granularity, receipt/attachment retrieval endpoints, explicit expense-report endpoints, independent hands-on corroboration.
